reference.role: Shared blue beastfolk base, clothing and drawing style

user_visual_approval: rejected: user finds clothing too enclosing and recurring skull headgear, red scarves and layered leather too uniform; requests moderate differences in face, physique and costume design

visual_inspection.shared_species: Blue skin, yellow eyes, pointed ears, broad nose, red cloth, brown leather and bone headgear shared with prior infantry/thrower.
visual_inspection.shieldbearer: Wide squat body, reinforced wooden shield, lowered cleaver, closed leather armor and trousers.
visual_inspection.healer: Narrower face with pointed chin, hooded robe, bone-topped staff and herb pouches.
visual_inspection.orientation: Both faces and torsos frontal, full body visible.
visual_inspection.limitations: Concept sheet with labels and off-white background, not a transparent animation master. Outer shield and staff-top margins are tighter than requested; no clipping visible. User has not approved this art or the earlier comparison.
